statements.t: By leveraging our AI-driven platform and expanding our enterprise footprint, we aim to deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that address the evolving needs of hybrid workplaces.

The timing, amount, price and manner of any repurchases will be determined by management based on market conditions, the Company’s financial position, liquidity and capital requirements, applicable legal requirements and limitations contained in the Company’s financing arrangements.
It excludes one-time projects, hardware sales and other revenue that management does not consider to be recurring in nature.

The Company recognizes revenue, in accordance with ASC 606, when control of the promised products or services is transferred to its customers, in an amount that reflects the consideration the Company expects to be entitled to in exchange for those products or services.
